data.fund_type: An open ended dynamic equity scheme investing across large cap, mid cap, small cap stocks
data.investment_objective: The primary investment objective of the Scheme is to seek to generate long term capital appreciation, from a portfolio that is substantially constituted of equity securities and equity related securities of issuers domiciled in India. This shall be the fundamental attribute of the Scheme. There is no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: 1. Equity & Equity related securities: 65% to 100% 2. Debt & Money market securities: 0% to 35%
data.exit_load: 1% - Holding period from the date of allotment < 12 months, Nil - Holding period from the date of allotment >= 12 months (as a% of Applicable NAV)
